2608.03984.title: string2string Studio: An Interactive, In-Browser Platform for String-to-String Algorithms
2608.03984.paper_summary: We present string2string Studio, an interactive in-browser platform for string-to-string analysis across natural language processing, computational biology, and the digital humanities. The system integrates six main modules (alignment, distance, similarity, search, generation metrics, and BLAST homology search), operating at character, word, token, line, and residue levels. Its C++-based algorithms compile to WebAssembly, so core operations run locally by default without any installation or data upload. The interface reports scores with their "evidence" (alignments, edit paths, metric matches, search hits, and homology traces), making methods inspectable, debuggable, and comparable on shared inputs. Internal benchmarks show speedups of up to 2,500x over the Python predecessor, faster global/local alignment than a general-purpose native C aligner, and exact agreement with independent references under declared settings. For homology search, the scoped client-side blastn path closely matches NCBI BLAST+ rankings and statistics under matched parameters. A curated showcase and Learn mode present canonical algorithms and metrics as reusable demonstrations. string2string Studio is open-source and freely available at string2string.org.
2608.03984.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了 string2string Studio，這是一個互動式的瀏覽器平台，專為自然語言處理、計算生物學和數位人文學的字串對字串分析而設計。該系統整合了六個主要模組（對齊、距離、相似性、搜尋、生成指標和 BLAST 同源搜尋），在字元、單詞、標記、行和殘基層級上運作。其基於 C++ 的演算法編譯為 WebAssembly，因此核心操作預設在本地運行，無需任何安裝或數據上傳。介面報告分數及其「證據」（對齊、編輯路徑、指標匹配、搜尋命中和同源痕跡），使方法可檢查、可調試且可在共享輸入上進行比較。內部基準測試顯示，相較於 Python 的前身，速度提升高達 2,500 倍，且在通用本地 C 對齊器中提供更快的全局/局部對齊，並在聲明的設置下與獨立參考完全一致。對於同源搜尋，範圍限制的客戶端 blastn 路徑與 NCBI BLAST+ 的排名和統計在匹配參數下緊密對應。一個精心策劃的展示和學習模式呈現了經典演算法和指標，作為可重用的示範。string2string Studio 是開源的，並可在 string2string.org 上免費獲得。
